title: haplopappus retinervius
intro: Haplopappus retinervius, commonly known as Rock Mountain Balsamroot, is a perennial herb native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Haplopappus retinervius include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
